Study_Title: Cross-Regime Empirical Investigation of Forecast Selection Policies vs Downstream Inventory Cost
Regimes_Evaluated: Walmart Weekly Store Sales (Smooth: ADI=1.00, CV^2=0.29)
Online Retail Daily SKU Panel (Lumpy/Erratic: 61.5% zeros, wholesale spikes)
M5 Grocery Series (Intermittent: ADI=3.57, CV^2=0.25, 69.8% zeros)
Policies_Evaluated: Policy A: Historical / Seasonal Naive Baseline
Policy B: Statistical Accuracy-First (Lowest Validation MAE)
Policy C: Operational Bias-Constrained (Lowest MAE with |Bias%| <= 5%)
Policy D: Cost-Aware (Lowest Estimated Inventory Cost on Validation Folds)

Walmart_Results.Benchmark_Entity: Store 1 ($ monetary inventory, L=2 weeks, alpha=95%, S=$2,500, i=0.20)

Policy_D_Cost_Aware.Selection_Criterion: Minimum Simulated Replenishment Cost on Walk-Forward Validation Folds

Online_Retail_Results.Holdout_Horizon: 28 days locked holdout (30 SKUs continuous panel)
Online_Retail_Results.Benchmark_Parameters: L=7 days, alpha=95%, S=$50, unit_cost=$10, p_shortage=$25

Policy_D_Cost_Aware.Selection_Criterion: Minimum Simulated Replenishment Cost on Walk-Forward Validation Folds

M5_Grocery_Results.Holdout_Horizon: 28 days locked holdout (20 grocery items panel)
M5_Grocery_Results.Benchmark_Parameters: L=7 days, alpha=95%, S=$20, unit_cost=$2, p_shortage=$5
